scripts.deploy:shard0: npm run check:local-ai-config && wrangler deploy -c generated-wrangler/wrangler.shard0.jsonc
scripts.deploy:all: npm run check:local-ai-config && for i in {0..24}; do echo "Deploying local-AI shard$i"; npx wrangler deploy -c generated-wrangler/wrangler.shard$i.jsonc; done
scripts.deploy:openai-only: NUTSNEWS_ALLOW_OPENAI_ONLY_DEPLOYMENT=true npm run generate:wrangler && for i in {0..24}; do echo "Deploying OpenAI-only shard$i"; npx wrangler deploy -c generated-wrangler/wrangler.shard$i.jsonc; done
